description: pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs: There is no test that calls ValidityMaxLint via run_cert with current time (operational mode) for a cert whose notBefore was pre-SC-081 but whose validity exceeds the post-SC-081 cap. This is the failure mode of PKIX-512.1 (SC-081 cap evaluated at wrong time). Without a test demonstrating the correct behavior, the bug cannot be regression-tested. Add: one test with now=post-SC-081, cert.notBefore=pre-SC-081, cert.validity=300d → should PASS (cap=398d at issuance); one test with now=post-SC-081, cert.notBefore=post-SC-081, cert.validity=300d → should FAIL (cap=200d at issuance).
title: No test for ValidityMaxLint in audit-mode vs operational-mode
